Horrible Burger
May 2018 • Couples
So this is my 19th day exploring Vietnam and this is the worst meal that I have eaten so far!

I was staying just a couple of blocks away and had walked past this restaurant several times. On this particular day a burger for dinner sounded good so I headed on over here, it's got burger in its name so they must make good burgers, right?

The burgers on the menu looked great, I finally decided on a Cheeseburger and I added Bacon. When the burger arrived it looked pretty much like the photo in the menu so I was expecting great things from this burger, unfortunately I was about to be greatly disappointed.

I took my first bite, the burger itself was soft and mushy and lacked flavor. The bacon was almost raw, I couldn't bite through it and ended up pulling out the whole piece as I pulled my mouth away, now I had a whole strip of bacon dangling from my mouth, I reached up, pulled it out of my mouth and put it on the plate. The bun was fat and doughy, each bite (I took three) felt like you had just stuffed half a loaf of bread into your mouth.

The burger was absolutely horrendous, I was hungry but I just couldn't stomach this monstrosity.

The one bright spot was the waitress, she was very sweet. It's not her fault that the restaurant she works for serves slop.

Decent burger with cheap beer!
Jun 2018 • Couples
The sign for the cheap beer caught our attention first. It wasn't bad for VND8,000 and the burger, fries and salad were not bad either. The service was a bit sluggish but didn't deter from the food and overall experience. If you're sitting outside round about 7pm the traffic can get noisy as it is on a busy intersection but not uncomfortable.

Awesome!!
Apr 2018 • Solo
Was passing by when I noticed this place. Food quality is very good, ordered caesar salads, fried noodles with seafood and caramel frapucino. Salads had more bacon then anywhere else I ate, fried noodles were tasty, maybe a little too salty, frapucinno was exactly what i needed. Payed for everything 200k vnd including tips. Overall experience, exceeded my expactations and will definitely come back to try the burgers and cocktails.
